input: Get the boiler serviced before the cold season

gold.taskTitle: Get Boiler Serviced Before Cold Season
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete a professional boiler service in time for the cold season.

questions.title: What type of boiler do you have at home?
questions.description: Identify the boiler type (e.g. gas, oil, electric, combi, system) to find the right engineer.

questions.title: When does the cold season typically start in your area?
questions.description: Establish the target deadline so the service can be booked well in advance.

questions.title: Has this boiler been serviced before, and if so when?
questions.description: Understand the service history to assess urgency and what the engineer may need to check.

questions.title: Do you already have a preferred engineer or company in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether finding and vetting a tradesperson is part of this task.

questions.title: Is the boiler showing any faults or warning signs right now?
questions.description: Identify whether there are existing issues that could affect booking priority or cost.

questions.title: Do you have a boiler warranty or service plan currently active?
questions.description: Check whether cover exists that dictates which engineer must be used or reduces cost.

questions.title: What is your rough budget for the service appointment?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to help filter engineer quotes appropriately.
